ruleDefinitions.name: Potential SentinelOne Shell Context Menu Scan Command Tampering
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potentially suspicious changes to the SentinelOne context menu scan command by a process other than SentinelOne. Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\shell\\\\SentinelOneScan\\\\command\\\\.*") AND  NOT (((Details = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\SentinelOne\\\\Sentinel\\ Agent") OR Details = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\SentinelOne\\\\Sentinel\\ Agent")) AND Details = RGX(".*\\\\SentinelScanFromContextMenu\\\.exe.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\SentinelOne\\\\$") OR process_path = RGX("C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\SentinelOne\\\\$")))
